Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Until response or maximum 1500 ms (shape-label pair)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms black screen at trial start
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: / (feedback 'incorrect'/'please respond faster' on error or timeout)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Geometric shapes (square and triangle), approx 5 degrees x 5 degrees visual angle
Stimulus_Properties.Label: German words: Ich (I), Fremder (stranger); Courier New 18-pt, approx 0.7 degrees visual angle

exp1.detail: Association phase: participants instructed that a shape (square/triangle) denotes them and another denotes a stranger (no images presented). Matching task always presented last, after the dot-probe task. Response keys: d (match), k (nonmatch). Data contain 34 participants x 128 trials (CSV Valid_Subj 28; N caliber difference tracked in PROJ_STATE.md stage 4). Method source: paper full text (Springer).
